Entry Etiquette and Judgment in the Stormlands Entry Etiquette and Judgment in the Stormlands Judgments tend to be quick and clear, and delay will be seen as weakness; but severity can also easily deepen old grudges; when a person is called "just", the locals may not agree with the southern court's interpretation of the word. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
